crossRefs.note: These likewise cast lots even as their brothers the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech…
crossRefs.keyword: as well the small as the great. Heb. or, as well for thesmall as for the great

crossRefs.note: They cast lots for their offices, all alike, the small as well as the great, the teacher as well as the student.
crossRefs.keyword: as well the small as the great. Heb. or, as well for thesmall as for the great

translations.web: They cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.
translations.bsb: They cast lots for each gate, according to their families, young and old alike.
translations.kjv: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.
translations.asv: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to their fathers' houses, for every gate.
